description: King County, Washington : streets (freeways) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors King County (Wash.). King County, Washington freeway lines. This datalayer is derived from and contains those links within the King County Street Network datalayer classified as freeways (road_class = "F"). Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties. Scale 1:24,000. Coverage: King County, Washington. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: Plots/maps displaying streets from this coverage must include a disclaimer indicating that the source of the data is from maps produced by Kroll. This. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
